reader_summary.overview: You can find other sessions from the event, covering the building blocks of crypto to decentralization to the regulatory landscape, here. What was the biggest surprise in the space? Do the same skills from other domains apply? This discussion, moderated by Kim Milosevich, explores these questions with Coinbase VP of Operations Tina Bhatnagar; CEO and founder of TruStory Preethi Kasireddy; and Lily Liu.
